problem: The abbreviation EDLC is used without being defined, and a reader on a phone cannot look it up mid-chapter.
fix: Spell it out once: "the integration and testing stage of the embedded design life cycle (EDLC)".

problem: "The boundary-scan register (BSR) has one cell for each device pin" is loose: supply and ground pins do not get cells, and special pins may differ.
fix: Say "one cell for each digital I/O (signal) pin of the device".

problem: The question asks for two reasons but the answer lists three (fault model misses defects, coverage below 100 percent, thresholds passing marginal boards).
fix: Either ask for "reasons" or trim the answer to two: the fault model misses real defects such as intermittent joints, and coverage is never 100 percent, so untested defects escape.
